headline: US Oil Drillers Turn Cautious as WTI Holds Near $85 per Barrel
summary: The total number of active drilling rigs for oil and gas in the United States rose this week, according to new data that Baker Hughes published on Friday, bringing the total rig count in the US to 588, up 48 from this same time last year.
